notes.title: Update on game release date!
notes.content:
[b]Hello again, fellow monster girl rescuers![/b]

First of all, I want to give you all a big shoutout for supporting 'Is It Wrong To Try To Rescue Monster Girls From The Inquisition?'! [b]You guys are absolute legends![/b]

Now, here's the scoop:

I couldn't resist the temptation to double the in-game fun and add in some extra story chapters (maybe even a few secret ones, who knows?).
But with great chapters come great development times, so this also means we'll need just a bit more time before this experience is in mint condition and ready to be released. So, let's push the release date back by around a month, okay?

I know, I know, the anticipation is killing us all... But while I was initially aiming for a very brief experience (maybe under an hour), with the exciting new additions in the story and the puzzle levels you can expect about [b]3 hours of short and sweet playtime[/b]. And it's going to be well polished on top of that.  

Don't worry, it's going to be worth it!

So while we patiently count down the days, let's rally the troops! Spread the word to your friends with an impeccable taste for top-notch entertainment. Let them know that this fun little yarn is on the horizon, waiting to be explored!

Thanks again for sticking with the game as it gets its final touches and dresses up for the big day!

If you have any burning questions or suggestions, hit up the discussions forum. I'm all ears and eager to chat with you!
